evidence.title: CHANGE REQUEST CR-2001-012
evidence.claim: Step ALK-07 was introduced in 2001 to prevent flash fires caused by adding white spirit to hot batches.
evidence.quote: Reason: flash fire IR-2001-007 - letdown of white spirit (flash point approx. 38 °C) into a hot batch.

evidence.title: INCIDENT REPORT IR-2001-007
evidence.claim: A flash fire occurred in June 2001 during white spirit letdown because the batch temperature was 58 °C.
evidence.quote: flash fire at the open manhole during the white spirit letdown. Batch temperature at letdown 58 °C

evidence.title: INCIDENT REPORT IR-2001-007
evidence.claim: The 2001 incident was caused by the batch temperature exceeding the white spirit flash point of 38 °C.
evidence.quote: white spirit flash point is about 38 °C; at 58 °C the batch was well above it

verdict.instruction: Cool the batch below 40 °C before solvent letdown and record the temperature (hold up to 30 min).
verdict.reason: The step was introduced to prevent flash fires caused by adding white spirit to batches exceeding its flash point (E3, E4, E5). The hazard remains as the current solvent (White spirit D40) has a flash point of 39 °C (E7), and antistatic hoses do not eliminate the solvent vapours (E6).
